# secureaccess_do_not_decrypt_list (Resource)

This resource manages a Do Not Decrypt List. The Secure Access API does not return the destinations and applications of a list, therefore changes made to them outside of Terraform are not detected and they are not populated by `terraform import`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_do_not_decrypt_list" "example" {
  name = "my_do_not_decrypt_list"
  destinations = [
    {
      destination = "example.com"
      comment     = "This is a comment for the destination."
    }
  ]
  applications                 = [101]
  decrypt_exception_categories = [12]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Do Not Decrypt List.

### Optional

- `applications` (Set of Number) IDs of the applications that are excluded from decryption.
- `decrypt_exception_categories` (Set of Number) IDs of the content categories that are excluded from decryption.
- `destinations` (Attributes Set) Destinations (domain names, URLs or IP addresses) that are excluded from decryption. At most 500 destinations can be sent in a single request, larger lists are split automatically. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `is_default` (Boolean) Specifies whether this is the default Do Not Decrypt List.
- `total_applications` (Number) Number of applications in the Do Not Decrypt List.
- `total_domains` (Number) Number of domains in the Do Not Decrypt List.
- `total_ips` (Number) Number of IP addresses in the Do Not Decrypt List.

<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Required:

- `destination` (String) The destination value (domain name, URL, IP address or CIDR block).

Optional:

- `comment` (String) Comment for the destination.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_do_not_decrypt_list.example "<id>"
```
